messages:
Asha (Sales AE): VertexLabs wants a 14-day Private POC, air-gapped. They asked for a concise preflight + how we hand ephemeral API access via a bastion. Need this for legal/procurement.
Luis (Infra Eng): I'll draft a short checklist: GPU driver, CUDA, kernel, container runtime, kubelet version, nvidia plugin, cgroup mode, time sync.
Tori (Solutions Eng): Ephemeral flow: Console mints signed grant -> bastion posts grant over mTLS -> exchange returns short-lived creds (1-6h). We'll include TLS cipher recommendations.
Nate (FieldTech): For air-gap we require: mirror of runtime images + helm chart tarball + small sample model. We provide a mirror script (Harbor/Quay/GCR compatible).
VertexLabs-ops: We use Harbor and have on-site Vault. Good to know you don't need key export.
Luis (Infra Eng): Correct: we call vault transit. No plaintext keys leave site. We'll note PKCS#11 support.
Tori (Solutions Eng): Ports to document: kube-apiserver 6443, node metrics 9100, DCGM ~9400, optional outbound 443 to artifact proxy.
Asha (Sales AE): Procurement wants a one-paragraph security summary and ballpark pricing for 4x A100 14d.
quote-bot: Created quote request vertex/1875554321. Finance will reply.
Nate (FieldTech): Quick local commands to run (safe non-admin):
    nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,driver_version --format=csv
    if command -v nvcc >/dev/null; then nvcc --version; fi
    uname -r; lsmod | egrep 'nvidia|nvrm' || true
    kubectl get nodes -o wide (view perms)

Luis (Infra Eng): Known gotchas: SELinux Enforcing can block mounts (recommend Permissive during install), older kernels (<5.4) may need patches for CUDA11+, cgroup v2 caveats.
Asha (Sales AE): Thanks — can you two assemble a one-page preflight + 3-bullet FAQ by EOD? I'll attach pricing when finance responds.
Tori (Solutions Eng): Will do. I will include openssl snippets for mTLS cert verification.
VertexLabs-ops: We'll run checks tomorrow 09:00 and post outputs.
Asha (Sales AE): Great, closing loop until we have their outputs.
